urls.title: Job Board URLs
urls.description: Greenhouse job board URLs to scrape. Each entry is an object with a required `url` and optional per-board filters (use the JSON tab): `departments` (array of integer department IDs to keep, filtered before fetching job details), `maxJobs` (integer cap per board), `daysBack` (integer; only jobs updated in the last N days). Example: {"url": "https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/gitlab", "departments": [4011044002], "maxJobs": 20, "daysBack": 7}. See README for how to find department IDs.
